captions.detailed: A kitchen blender featuring a wide, low-profile black base with a front control panel hosting five rectangular grey push buttons. Mounted on top of the base is a translucent, slightly tapered square blending jar with a grey lid. Inside the bottom of the jar, a small metallic blade assembly is visible. The five front buttons can be depressed independently via prismatic joints, while the internal blade assembly is designed to spin continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a kitchen blender with a wide black base, five independent grey push buttons on a front control panel, and a translucent square jar mounted on top. Ensure the five buttons are configured with prismatic joints, and the internal blade assembly is set up with a continuous rotational joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main blender body by creating a wide base using a box primitive with chamfered or sloped front edges. Model the translucent jar using a hollowed, tapered extrusion or box, and add a flat lid. Create five small rectangular box primitives for the buttons, aligning them horizontally along the front of the base. Model the internal blade using thin cylindrical or box cross-members. Set up five prismatic joints for the buttons with translation limits, and one continuous revolute joint for the blade assembly.
